Phone mode: let the agent operate this device

High-risk controls (pay, purchase, transfer, delete, uninstall, confirm order) always pause for the approval dialog. The model\'s own confirmed argument is ignored: only your tap on Allow can approve an action.
Paste an API credential under Settings to chat with a live model, or just press Send to run the offline scripted demo.
No credential stored — running the local scripted provider instead of the network.
Phone mode needs a live model. Paste an API credential under Settings first.
The accessibility service is not connected. Turn phone mode on again once it is enabled.
The accessibility service is enabled but not connected yet. Wait a moment and toggle phone mode again.

Phone mode uses an accessibility service to read the current screen and perform taps and text input on your behalf. Nothing runs until you enable the Agent Harness service in the system accessibility settings and start a turn yourself. High-risk actions always pause for your approval.
The agent wants to %1$s the control labeled \"%2$s\". Only this dialog can approve the action — the model cannot approve itself. Deny if you are not sure.
